S_A.meaning: on the hidden side, S can see only points with z below this value (close to the wall)

S_B.meaning: on the hidden side, S can see only points with z below this value (close to the wall)

frameA_outer_pair_only.meaning: outer pair only: in a pure band-intersection picture the inner points add almost nothing; the spread of the wall points (aperture span), not their count, sets the crossing angle

crossing_estimate.formula: long = 2*delta/sin(alpha); on the bisector sin(alpha) = w/sqrt(w^2+z^2), w = half the wall-point spread, z = distance from the wall

frameA_plus_B1_sensor_moved_fused.wall_points_used: W_A1..4 + W_B1..4 (object static, plain intersection is valid)

frameA_and_B2_naive_intersection.meaning: plain intersection of frame A and frame B2 bands, wrongly assuming the person stood still

frameA_and_B2_plain_stacking_best_cells.meaning: plain averaging/stacking: best-agreeing cells; spans both positions (smear) when the person moved

frameA_then_B2_motion_compensated.meaning: motion-compensated: move frame-A candidates by any step up to the motion-prior radius, then keep those consistent with frame-B2 bands (what a particle filter's predict+update does)
